subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference — multi-team scheduling
body:
Message 1
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@atlasbank.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference for transaction monitoring

Hi Marissa,

We recently filled out the form on your site asking for a demo focused on using Redwood for transaction monitoring and fraud detection. A few quick details:
- Company: Atlas Bank (global retail bank)
- Primary stakeholders: Payments product team (London), Security/IT (Singapore), Business ops (New York)
- Main ask: see latency/cost tradeoffs, security controls, and integration pattern for streaming transaction feeds

Would anyone from your team be available next week for a 45–60m demo? We’ll need an SE present for architecture and our security lead to confirm compliance posture.

Thanks,
Sarah Jenkins\Product Manager, Payments\Atlas Bank

---

Message 2
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-01T10:03:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Demo request: Redwood Inference for transaction monitoring

Aditya — can you take point on scheduling and coordinate SE coverage? Connor should join for the architecture deep-dive. Customer explicitly wants IT/security there (Singapore). Suggest 60 minutes to cover integration + security questions.

Priority: treat as inbound SDR follow; goal is demo this week if possible.

Thanks,
Marissa

Forwarded message:
> From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@atlasbank.com>
> Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-05:00
> Subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference for transaction monitoring
> To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
>
> [Original message above]

---

Message 3
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@atlasbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-02T08:15:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference for transaction monitoring

Hi Sarah — thanks for the request and context. Happy to coordinate. Connor (SE) and I will run the session; Marissa is looped in for AEs and next steps. To make sure we have the right people, can you confirm the security contact(s) and whether any NDAs/PO required before a deeper compliance discussion?

Proposed slots (all listed with local conversions below to help your distributed team):
1) Wednesday Mar 3 — 09:00 ET / 14:00 GMT / 22:00 SGT (60m)
2) Wednesday Mar 3 — 13:00 ET / 18:00 GMT / 02:00 SGT (Thursday) (60m)
3) Thursday Mar 4 — 07:00 ET / 12:00 GMT / 20:00 SGT (60m)

If none of those work, tell us a few windows that work for payments, security, and ops and we’ll find a match. I can send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Cheers,
Aditya\SDR, Redwood Inference\[Attachment: demo_agenda.docx] (agenda draft)

---

Message 4
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@atlasbank.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-02T10:02:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference for transaction monitoring

Thanks, Aditya.
We need the security team there — please include Mike Hu (mike.hu@atlasbank.com) — he’s our head of platform security in Singapore. Also: the Payments PM (that's me) will be remote; the engineering lead is in London (GMT).

Slots: Option 1 is hard for our London engineering lead (late in their day). Option 2 falls at 02:00 SGT for Mike, so he’s unlikely to join. Option 3 (Thursday Mar 4, 07:00 ET / 12:00 GMT / 20:00 SGT) looks best for cross-region attendance. Can you confirm Connor can do option 3?

Also, would appreciate a 1-pager on security controls ahead of the meeting if possible.

Sarah
Product Manager, Payments\Atlas Bank

---

Message 5
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@atlasbank.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T16:40:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference for transaction monitoring

On Tue, Mar 2, 2026 at 10:02 AM Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@atlasbank.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Aditya.
> We need the security team there — please include Mike Hu (mike.hu@atlasbank.com) — he’s our head of platform security in Singapore.
>
> Slots: Option 1 is hard for our London engineering lead (late in their day). Option 2 falls at 02:00 SGT for Mike, so he’s unlikely to join. Option 3 (Thursday Mar 4, 07:00 ET / 12:00 GMT / 20:00 SGT) looks best for cross-region attendance. Can you confirm Connor can do option 3?

Hi all — option 3 works for me. I’ll block the time and bring the architecture/latency slides and a quick runbook for integrating streaming feeds. If anything changes I’ll ping here.

Connor O'Brien\Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference\

---

Message 6
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@atlasbank.com>, Mike Hu <mike.hu@atlasbank.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai, rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-04T14:45:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Redwood Inference for transaction monitoring

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Thursday Mar 4, 07:00 ET / 12:00 GMT / 20:00 SGT (60 minutes).
Agenda (60m):
- 5m: Introductions & goals (Sarah)
- 15m: Product overview & expected latency/cost tradeoffs (Marissa)
- 20m: Architecture deep-dive + integration patterns (Connor)
- 15m: Security controls & compliance Q&A (Connor + Redwood Security one-pager)
- 5m: Next steps & mutual action plan

Attendees we have so far: Sarah Jenkins (Payments PM), Mike Hu (Platform Security), London Eng Lead (TBD), Marissa (AE), Connor (SE), Aditya (SDR). If there are others please reply with names/emails so we can add them to the invite.

I’ve attached a short security one-pager and the demo agenda; I’ll also send a calendar invite with video link and dial-in.

[Attachment: redwood_security_onepager.pdf]
[Attachment: demo_invite_20260304.ics]
[Attachment: demo_agenda.docx]

Looking forward — see you Thursday.

Marissa Cole\Account Executive, Redwood Inference\marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

---

Final notes: Calendar invite sent separately (see related link). If Atlas has any pre-demo security checklist or an internal form, Mike — feel free to share and we’ll prep answers beforehand.
